answer: Behavioral ripple correlation. Each identity's action timing and counterparty set is recorded; the detector measures whether a zephyr of new accounts shares sub-second timing clusters or overlapping counterparty graphs with known sybils. A whisper of shared infrastructure—same IP prefix, same sleep cycle—raises correlation scores. Enforcement: flagged clusters face throttled throughput proportional to cluster size. Cost: an attacker must simulate independent timing jitter and distinct counterparty histories per identity, roughly hours of manual divergence per account.
